posts.text:
Once again, Trump is threatening to commit a war crime.


Jake Tapper 🦅 (@jaketapper)

Trump tells Iran that if they don’t agree to his “very fair and reasonable DEAL” the US will “knock out every single Power Plant, and every single Bridge, in Iran.“

Targeting civilian infrastructure is widely considered a war crime under the Geneva conventions.







— https://nitter.net/jaketapper/status/2045848118097273302#m

Trump’s unconstitutional war was not authorized by Congress, was started without a plan or an exit strategy, and has achieved none of the contradictory objectives used to justify it.

Oh, and it cost taxpayers at least $40 billion.

Gaslight [verb]: to grossly mislead or deceive (someone) especially for one's own advantage.


The Hill (@thehill)

#BREAKING: Trump says energy secretary ‘totally wrong’ on gas prices not dropping to $3 until next year thehill.com/homenews/adminis…




— https://nitter.net/thehill/status/2046208686758981968#m

Visited City of Hope in Torrance last week to meet with health care professionals advancing cutting-edge clinical trials and AI-driven treatments. Their work is a reminder that true leadership means investing in people, science, and solutions that improve lives.

We must keep fighting to ensure every American has access to quality, affordable health care.

We have a cost of living emergency.

Video

There’s something mentally wrong with the president of the United States.

Video

ICE and Border Patrol should be held to the same standards as real police officers.

Video

Republican leaders rushed a 2 AM vote to let the government spy on Americans without a warrant.

It’s good they failed.

Americans are rightfully afraid of government overreach. We need to prioritize protecting their personal data & not force bills through in the dark of night.

Trump needs to focus on the cost-of-living emergency and stop doing stupid stuff like attacking the Pope.

Video

Friendly reminder that Trump Tariffs will cost families an extra $2,500 this year.


More Perfect Union (@MorePerfectUS)

On Monday the Trump admin will launch the tariff refund system for the $166 billion in tariffs they illegally collected.

And all of that money will go to companies.

56,497 ​importers are set to get refunds so far, with no requirement they pass that money along to customers.



— https://nitter.net/MorePerfectUS/status/2044776610998390876#m

Trump’s tax cuts made this possible. For the ultra-wealthy and Trump’s pals, life is good.


POLITICO (@politico)

Oil company founded by energy secretary paid no US taxes last year dlvr.it/TS3Sq0




— https://nitter.net/politico/status/2044506704600305910#m

Update: The Trump admin recently cancelled an $11 million Catholic Charities contract to provide shelter and care for children entering the U.S. alone. They will be forced to shut down within three months.


Pope Leo XIV (@Pontifex)

Woe to those who manipulate religion and the very name of God for their own military, economic, and political gain, dragging that which is sacred into darkness and filth. #ApostolicJourney #Cameroon vatican.va/content/leo-xiv/e…



— https://nitter.net/Pontifex/stat

It’s time to end what never should have started.

Video

No one should be worshipping Donald Trump.

Video

Trump’s war of choice will cause households to spend an extra $740 extra on gas this year.

Meanwhile, Trump used his presidency to boost his net worth by $3 billion.

forbes.com/sites/danalexande…

Donald Trump will reap what he sows.

Video

House Republicans must join us to end this reckless war.


The New York Times (@nytimes)

Breaking News: War in the Middle East has upended the global economy, the International Monetary Fund warned in a report, raising the possibility of a worldwide recession. nyti.ms/4cH3umC




— https://nitter.net/nytimes/status/2044050214525268462#m

This is not about politics. This is about protecting our country.


Andrew Solender (@AndrewSolender)
